mutations.label: 64a back to doc.isbn[0], the state that sent a Chinese ISBN to a US bookshop
64b the English preference is dropped, so any ISBN-13 wins
64c the English range grows to include 978-7, which is China
64d shape validation is dropped, so a wiki edit reaches the spreadsheet
64e hyphens survive into the retailer url

equivalent.label: 64h `if (!isbns?.length) return isbns?.[0];`
equivalent.why: EQUIVALENT, not a hole. The branch is only reached when the array is empty or absent, and `[]?.[0]` IS undefined - so the mutant returns exactly what the original returns, for every input that can reach it. Pinned by the assertion `expect(pickIsbn([])).toBeUndefined()`, which is the invariant that makes it equivalent. Kept here rather than deleted so nobody re-derives it as a missing test.
